source: synthetic GeM bid for desktop computers (evals/golden/in/gem_desktops)

requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 45,00,000 over the last three financial years.
The bidder shall furnish an EMD of Rs. 2,40,000 through the GeM online payment gateway before the bid end date.
The bidder shall have at least 3 years of past experience in supplying desktop computers to government buyers.
MSEs registered under Udyam are exempted from the EMD on submission of a valid Udyam certificate; startups are not exempted for this bid.
The bidder shall be a registered seller on the Government e-Marketplace with the relevant product category approved.
1.1 The seller shall deliver all 120 desktop computers to the consignee locations within 45 days of the supply order.
1.2 The seller shall provide a comprehensive on-site warranty of three years covering parts and labour.
1.3 The seller must supply units bearing a valid BIS registration mark for IT equipment.
1.4 The seller shall install the operating system and the buyer's standard image on every unit before handover.
1.5 The seller should provide a single point of contact for warranty escalations across all consignee locations.
All documents shall be uploaded in PDF format and shall not exceed 10 MB per file.
The technical and financial bids shall be submitted online on the GeM portal before 05:00 PM IST on 20-11-2026.
The bidder shall digitally sign every uploaded document with a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate.
The bidder shall upload the Udyam registration certificate where an MSE exemption is claimed.
Bids will be evaluated on the lowest landed price (L1) among technically qualified bidders.
Technical qualification will be assessed against the minimum specification sheet and the submitted BIS certificate.
